package.name: drivetrain_bringup
package.description: Top-level bringup for the UWRobotics Sparky drivetrain. Launches the ros2_control stack (diff_drive_controller over mock or ODrive hardware) with RViz visualization, and optionally the PS4 teleop. Composes the launch files from sparky_description and groundstation_bringup.
package.author: UWRobotics Team
